snippet.title: Dungeon Maker Hunting Ground Ep1 - Introduction & Floor One
snippet.description:
Dungeon Maker Hunting Ground is a RPG game revolves around building your own dungeon.
Player gets to design a 100% unique dungeon to attract wide variety of monsters. Customize your dungeon strategically to lure the most sought-after enemies, place "treasure rooms" for the monsters to hid away their most precious loots.
